question: What is the role of the rubber seal in the wheel cylinder?

options.text: To connect the piston to the brake shoe

solution:
The correct answer is __To prevent brake fluid leakage.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rubber seal__ is an essential component of the wheel cylinder in a braking system.
 
• The primary function of the rubber seal is to prevent brake fluid leakage.
 
• It ensures that the hydraulic pressure in the wheel cylinder is maintained for effective braking.
 
• By preventing leaks, the rubber seal also improves the durability of the braking system.
 
• Proper maintenance of the rubber seal is crucial for the safe operation of the braking system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hydraulic Braking System:**

 
 
• A hydraulic braking system uses brake fluid to transfer pressure from the brake pedal to the wheel cylinders.
 
• The wheel cylinder contains pistons that press the brake shoes or pads against the drum or disc.
 
 
 
• **Brake Fluid:**
 
 
• Brake fluid is a hydraulic fluid used to transmit force in the braking system.
 
• It must be resistant to heat and maintain its properties over a wide range of temperatures.
 
 
 
• **Brake Shoe:**
 
 
• Brake shoes are curved friction plates that press against the drum to slow down or stop the vehicle.
 
• They are commonly found in drum brake systems.
